delete_preconditions: catalogue rebuilt and graph validation PASS
candidate node not reachable as irreducible root
reconstruction plan exists if node is CACHE/CACHE_EXPENSIVE
at least one independent replay proof for the target preservation closure
object-store hash verification before and after gc transaction journal
